# Function reference

All **120** keywords known to the mod, grouped by the category used in
`functions.json`. Signatures follow the original convention:

* `<name>` — required argument;
* `[name]` — optional argument;
* `<&name>` — argument is a variable that receives a **string**;
* `<#name>` — argument is a variable that receives a **number**;
* `<name[]>` — argument is an array.

Keyword names are matched case-insensitively by the transpiler and are
written in upper case here for readability.

---

## Control Flow

Blocks that decide what runs: conditionals, loops, waits.

| Keyword | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BREAK` | `BREAK` | Interrupts exection of the innermost loop. |
| `DO` | `DO([count])` | Begins a loop. |
| `ELSE` | `ELSE` | The actions following this action will only be executed if no if-clause beforeevaluated to true. |
| `ELSEIF` | `ELSEIF(<condition>)` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <condition>evaluates to true and no if-clause before evaluated to true. |
| `ENDIF` | `ENDIF` | Ends an IF block. |
| `ENDUNSAFE` | `ENDUNSAFE` | Ends an UNSAFE block. |
| `FOR` | `FOR(<#var>,<start>,<end>,[step])` | Begins a for loop using the specified var as a loop counter. Needs to be closed withNEXT. |
| `FOREACH` | `FOREACH(<iterator>)` | Runs a loop over the specified iterator. Needs to be closed with NEXT. |
| `IF` | `IF(<condition>)` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <condition>evaluates to true. |
| `IFBEGINSWITH` | `IFBEGINSWITH(<haystack>,<needle>)` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <haystack>starts with <needle>. |
| `IFCONTAINS` | `IFCONTAINS(<haystack>,<needle>)` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <haystack>starts with <needle>. |
| `IFENDSWITH` | `IFENDSWITH(<haystack>,<needle>)` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <haystack> endswith <needle>. |
| `IFMATCHES` | `IFMATCHES(<subject>,<pattern>,[&target],[group],[default])` | The actions following this action will only be executed when the <subject>matches the <pattern>. |
| `IIF` | `IIF(<condition>,<truetext>,[falsetext])` | Inline IF statement. |
| `LOOP` | `LOOP` | Ends a loop. |
| `NEXT` | `NEXT` | Ends a iteration of a loop. |
| `STOP` | `STOP([id])` | Stops the current macro, or macros matching the specified ID |
| `UNSAFE` | `UNSAFE(<executions>)` | Begins an UNSAFE block with maximum executions set to <executions>. |
| `UNTIL` | `UNTIL(<condition>)` | Completes a loop started with DO but exits the loop if <condition> is met. |
| `WAIT` | `WAIT(<time>)` | Pauses the script for the time (in seconds) specified, suffix ms for a wait inmilliseconds or t to wait in ticks. |
| `WHILE` | `WHILE(<condition>)` | Completes a loop started with DO but exits the loop if <condition> is not met |

## Variables

Read and change variables, arrays and flags.

| Keyword | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ARRAYSIZE` | `ARRAYSIZE(<array[]>,[#outvar])` | Stores the size of the specified <array[]> in [#outvar]. |
| `DEC` | `DEC(<#var>,[amount])` | Decrements the specified counter by 1 or by the specified amount |
| `INC` | `INC(<#var>,[amount])` | Increments the specified counter by 1 or by the specified amount |
| `INDEXOF` | `INDEXOF(<array[]>,<#outvar>,<searchfor>,[casesensitiv])` | Gets the first index of <searchfor> in <array[]> and stores it in <#outvar>. |
| `JOIN` | `JOIN(<glue>,<array[]>,[&output])` | Combines all values inside <array[]> with <glue> and stores it optionally in[&output]. |
| `POP` | `POP(<array[]>,<outvar>)` | Removes the last entry from the end of <array[]> and stores it in <outvar>. |
| `PUSH` | `PUSH(<array[]>,<value>)` | Appends <value> to the end of <array[]> |
| `PUT` | `PUT(<array[]>,<value>)` | Inserts <value> at the first empty point in <array[]>. |
| `SET` | `SET(<target>,[value])` | Sets the value of <target> to [value]. |
| `SPLIT` | `SPLIT(<delimiter>,<source>,[output[]])` | Splits the supplied <source> string on every <delimiter> into <output[]>. |
| `TOGGLE` | `TOGGLE([flag])` | Toggles the specified boolean [flag] value |
| `UNSET` | `UNSET(<flag>)` | Un-sets the specified <flag> variable. |

## Calculations

Maths, string handling, regex, item and block queries.

| Keyword | Signature | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CALCYAWTO` | `CALCYAWTO(<xpos>,<zpos>,[#yaw],[#distance])` | Calculates the absolute yaw angle and optionally the distance to the specified |
| `DECODE` | `DECODE(<input>,[&output])` | Converts an string from base64 back to an normal string. |
| `ENCODE` | `ENCODE(<input>,[&output])` | Converts an string to base 64. |
| `GETID` | `GETID(<x>,<y>,<z>,[&idvar],[#datavar])` | Gets the ID and optionally the data value of the block at the specified coordinates |
| `GETIDREL` | `GETIDREL(<xoffset>,<yoffset>,<zoffset>,[&idvar],[#datavar])` | Gets the ID and optionally the data value of the block at the specified coordinates |
| `GETITEMINFO` | `GETITEMINFO(<item[:damage]>,[&namevar],[#maxstacksize],[&type],[&dropid])` | Gets the name and other info for the specified item id |
| `LCASE` | `LCASE(<input>,[&output])` | Converts the input string to lower case and stores it in output. |
| `MATCH` | `MATCH(<subject>,<pattern>,[&target],[group],[default])` | Runs a regular expression match on the <subject> and puts the result in<&target>. |
| `RANDOM` | `RANDOM(<#target>,[max],[min])` | Assigns a random number between min and max to target. |
| `REGEXREPLACE` | `REGEXREPLACE(<&subject>,<pattern>,[replace])` | Replace all matches of <pattern> with [replace] in <&subject>. |
| `REPLACE` | `REPLACE(<&subject>,<search>,[replace])` | Replace all occurrences of <search> with [replace] in <&subject>. |
| `SQRT` | `SQRT(<value>,[#outvar])` | Calculate the rounded square root of <value> and store it in <#outvar>. |
| `STRIP` | `STRIP(<&target>,<text>)` | Strips all formatting codes from the specified <text> and assigns the result to<&target>. |
| `TIME` | `TIME(<&target>,[format])` | Stores the current time and date into &target, optionally using format specified. |
| `TRACE` | `TRACE(<distance>,[entities])` | Performs a ray trace operation which sets the raytrace variables in the local scope. |
| `UCASE` | `UCASE(<input>,[&output])` | Converts the input string to upper case and stores it in output. |
